families.name: SeeDance
families.tagline: State-of-the-art human choreography, character swaps, and 30-second sequence directing
families.overview: SeeDance 2.0 & 2.5 lead the industry in complex human body movement, multi-reference character consistency, and long-form sequence generation. From dance numbers and action choreography to swapping characters into live-action footage, SeeDance offers unmatched flexibility.
strengths: Up to 30 reference images for character and wardrobe locking
Extended 30-second multi-shot sequences in 480p, 720p, and 1080p
KarakterSD and Karakter Animate precision face and body re-targeting
Draft tiers for rapid 40-credit prototyping before high-res 1080p rendering
families.tips: Upload 2-3 clean reference images of your character from front, three-quarter, and action angles to maximize facial identity preservation.

families.name: Kling AI
families.tagline: High-fidelity cinematic motion, realistic physics, and expressive dialogue generation
families.overview: Kling is one of the premier cinematic video foundation models in production. Known for superb camera movement comprehension, prompt adherence, and complex multi-shot sequences, Kling gives directors the ability to simulate high-budget movie scenes with believable physics.
strengths: Natural camera control (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, arc)
High-frame-rate physical dynamics (fluid, cloth, collisions)
Kling Omni & Karakter face consistency pipelines
Extended 10-second multi-shot storytelling takes
families.tips: Use dynamic lighting and camera descriptors like "35mm anamorphic, slow tracking shot, volumetric dusk lighting" for best cinematic render quality.

families.name: Google Veo
families.tagline: High-definition 1080p generation with natural speech and synchronized sound design
families.overview: Google Veo 3 delivers state-of-the-art cinematic video generation with a breakthrough feature: synchronized, in-context dialogue and atmospheric audio. Veo understands film terminology like timelapse, aerial shots, and depth-of-field with precision.
strengths: Synchronized character dialogue with natural cadence and tone
Atmospheric environmental audio and spatial sound effects
Native 1080p high definition output with crisp edge fidelity
Deep understanding of cinematic lighting styles and lenses
families.tips: Wrap dialogue in quotation marks inside your prompt (e.g. A captain on the bridge says "Engage thrusters now") to trigger accurate lip-sync and voice delivery.

families.name: Runway
families.tagline: Industry-standard Gen-4 & Gen-4.5 generative tools for stylized, commercial, and hybrid pipelines
families.overview: Runway has long set the benchmark for AI video tools in film and advertising studios. Gen-4.5 delivers hyperrealistic camera motion and seamless keyframe interpolation, making it the workhorse for commercials, music videos, and fashion films.
strengths: Gen-4.5 image-to-video with unmatched initial frame fidelity
Funway pipeline fusing Flux Pro photorealism with Runway motion
Aleph keyframe sequence transformation
Clean film grain and premium color grading rendering
families.tips: Anchor your first frame with high-resolution reference portraits or Flux renders to lock in character wardrobe and facial structure.

families.name: Wan 2.1 & WanVACE
families.tagline: Open-weights powerhouse excelling in stylized anime, vibrant action, and budget-friendly video-to-video
families.overview: Wan 2.1 has revolutionized generative video with its open-weights architecture. It brings extraordinary visual flair to anime, futuristic sci-fi, dynamic fight scenes, and video-to-video editing via WanVACE at exceptional credit economy.
strengths: Vibrant stylized aesthetics, anime, and high-energy action sequences
WanVACE video-to-video conditioning at 420p and 720p
10-second multi-shot sequence generation
Competitive credit rates with 1080p Pro upgrade option
families.tips: Wan is the top recommendation for anime, concept art motion, and cybernetic/fantasy aesthetics. Include vivid lighting color palettes in your prompt.

families.name: Google Gemini & Nano
families.tagline: Advanced multimodal reference editing, 4K image transformations, and hybrid engines
families.overview: Powered by Gemini 3.1 Flash and Pro vision architectures, the Nano family provides the surgical precision required to edit character features, swap props, and prepare reference keyframes for video engines.
strengths: Nano 2 4K high-resolution reference preparation
Nano Aleph & Nano Flash hybrid video transformation pipelines
Support for up to 14 multi-element reference anchors
Natural language reference manipulation ("change the red jacket to leather")
families.tips: Refer specifically to elements of your reference image in your prompt ("keep the face from ref 1, replace the car in the background with a 1970s Mustang").

families.name: xAI Grok
families.tagline: Ultra-fast, budget-friendly 720p drafting and animatics for rapid ideation
families.overview: Grok Imagine Video is 10zebra's fastest and most cost-effective video model. At just 20 credits per take, it allows producers to brainstorm dozens of narrative beats, visual ideas, and camera angles before committing to high-cost final renders.
strengths: Lowest credit cost per take in the industry (from 20 credits)
Sub-20 second generation turnaround for live directing sessions
Fast 4-frame storyboard ideation and rapid image editing
Ideal for animatics, mood reels, and story pacing tests
families.tips: Use Grok in your initial storyboarding phase to quickly map out 10-15 scene variations, then graduate hero shots to Kling or Veo for final export.

families.name: LTX Video
families.tagline: Real-time video conditioning with fast temporal coherence and retake capabilities
families.overview: LTX Video is engineered specifically for fast video-to-video conditioning and shot retakes. It allows creators to take an existing video take and re-prompt specific elements while preserving camera movement.
strengths: High-speed video-to-video transformation at 1080p
LTX-2 Retake pipeline for repairing awkward motion beats
Prompt-modified first-frame conditioning with Nano integration
Budget-friendly turnaround for iterative revisions
families.tips: Use LTX-2 Retake when you love the camera path of a take but want to modify the character clothing, background season, or lighting atmosphere.

families.name: Minimax
families.tagline: High-speed camera motion, explosive action, and fluid human movement
families.overview: MiniMax 01 specializes in rapid camera moves, complex physics, and dynamic action shots that challenge traditional AI video models.
strengths: Outstanding handling of fast-moving subjects (vehicles, sports, action)
Smooth interpolation from initial keyframe
Natural physical deformation and motion blur simulation
Fixed cost rate with reliable generation success
families.tips: Ideal for chase sequences, sports highlights, and fast tracking shots where other models introduce warping.
